descriptionHtml:
"Brand You" is an enlightening event specially designed to offer invaluable insights for young minds venturing into the engineering field. The event mainly aimed to equip them with the essential knowledge and strategies to enhance their skills and market themselves effectively in the competitive job market. From crafting compelling resumes to leveraging digital platforms for professional networking, "Brand You" provided a comprehensive toolkit for career-seeking graduates to differentiate themselves and stand out in their field. By empowering attendees with practical skills and confidence, the event sets them on a path towards success in their engineering careers.

We were honored to have Prof. Maheshi Dissanayake, the advisor of IEEE WIE Student Branch AG at the University of Peradeniya, as our esteemed guest speaker. Leveraging her extensive experience and leadership in the field, Prof. Maheshi shared valuable insights and practical tips on personal branding and career development. Her expertise played a pivotal role in shaping the event, ensuring that it provided meaningful guidance and inspiration to young engineering enthusiasts. Her contributions helped make the event fruitful by guiding participants towards realizing their potential and navigating their career paths with confidence and purpose.
venue: Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering, Seminar room, Faculty of Engineering,
